integrity: The proof uses explicit bijections and inequalities; a bundled finite checker supplements but does not replace the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements for integers \(u\ge2\), \(i\ge2\), \(0\le p\le\lfloor P_i(u)/u\rfloor+1\). No classification for subsequent \(p\) or its genus; independent audit not performed; unindexed equivalences remain a risk.
title: A sharp first \(p\)-Frobenius phase for three consecutive Pell-type numbers
